rthst8fj.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Frosted Tips - White - 150 cm
rthst8fj.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Frosted Tips - White - 150 cm
rthst8fj.sourceDescription: This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree redefines seasonal décor with its realistic appearance and innovative design, transforming any living space into a festive haven. Its modern style and lifelike leaf arrangement make it a captivating centerpiece for homes during the holiday season while maintaining a sleek, minimal aesthetic. Crafted with simplicity and functionality in mind, this tree is easily assembled, blending seamlessly into various décor styles and imbuing environments with the warmth and joy synonymous with Christmas. Materials: Crafted from high-grade PVC and steel, offering durability and a realistic look. The materials ensure the tree withstands multiple seasons while retaining its visual appeal. This blend not only adds to the longevity but also enhances the visual aesthetics of the tree, making it look lush and full. Included Components: Equipped with decorative string lights that seamlessly adorn the tree, providing a warm white glow that enhances its natural look. Coupled with a reliable metal stand that ensures the tree stays upright and stable throughout the festive season. Features /Function /Design: The hinged construction allows for quick setup and disassembly, saving both time and effort. The lifelike tips give it a fresh, full appearance, while the foldable stand provides convenience for storage and stability in use. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms, this tree can complement a variety of home decors, enhancing the holiday spirit. It transforms spaces with its decorative lights and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions for optimal stability. Ensure the LED lights are handled with care to maintain their function and longevity. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 104 cm Stand size: 35 cm Hinged construction for set up, Lifelike Tips, Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 519 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Cable length: 200 cm Indoor use only Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

6jhe3gc9.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 124.5 cm
6jhe3gc9.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 124.5 cm
6jhe3gc9.sourceDescription: This Contemporary Metal Christmas Tree embodies the fusion of modern design aesthetics and traditional holiday spirit. Its sleek metal structure brings an unconventional chic to any living space, garden, or terrace, offering a refreshing alternative to traditional evergreen trees. With the minimalist yet elegant design, this tree becomes a versatile decor piece, perfect for those who appreciate a contemporary touch during the festive season. Standing tall, it is an eye-catching centerpiece that captivates attention and adds a unique festive charm to your home. Materials: The tree is constructed from powder-coated steel, known for its abrasion resistance, which ensures longevity and maintains the tree's aesthetic appeal over the years. This material choice provides the tree with robustness, capable of withstanding the hustle and bustle of the festive arrangements without compromising its design. The powder coating also gives the tree a non-reflective, matte finish that blends seamlessly with any contemporary decor theme. Included Components: Delivered as 1 x Metal Christmas tree, the tree includes a sturdy steel stand for reliable support. Its construction ensures it holds firmly in place whether adorning your living room or the terrace. This essential component allows the tree to remain upright, providing a stable base that invites creativity in decorating with your favorite ornaments and lights. Features /Function /Design: With a contemporary design, this tree stands out as a striking holiday decoration. Its non-traditional form encourages versatility in holiday layouts, allowing users to integrate it into various interior styles, from minimalistic to modern chic. The tree’s design is characterized by a sleek, streamlined look, making it an appealing accent piece year-round. Recommended Uses: Perfect for indoor and sheltered outdoor use, the tree can beautify living rooms, gardens, and terraces. It serves not only as a Christmas tree but transforms these spaces into festive retreats, allowing homeowners to express their modern style and creativity during the holiday season. Care &Maintenance: Assembly requires only one person and a screwdriver, following the manufacturer's instructions. This simplified process ensures that homeowners can set up the tree effortlessly. When not in use, disassemble with care to maintain its structural integrity and store it to protect the finish for future holidays. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: Powder-coated steel Tree height: 124.5 cm Stand size: 47 x 20 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Metal Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
